findings.evidence: Lattice.lean:357 `end TauCeti`, :363 `namespace AddMonoidHom`, :370 `structure IsIntegralLattice`; IntegralLattice/Basic.lean:61 `structure IntegralLattice`; scripts/lean_source.py:708 skips declarations whose first namespace component is not `TauCeti`, so the root placement also escapes the repo's dot-notation lint.
findings.fix: Move the section inside `namespace TauCeti` (`TauCeti.AddMonoidHom.…`) and pick a name that does not read as the predicate of the existing `IntegralLattice` (e.g. `IsFullLatticeMap`).
findings.issue: The whole new API is declared after `end TauCeti` (line 357) in Mathlib's root `AddMonoidHom` namespace, so the public surface is `AddMonoidHom.IsIntegralLattice.*`. Every other declaration this repo adds to a Mathlib namespace lives under `TauCeti.` (e.g. `TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue`, `TauCeti.Derivation.*` in scripts/lint-dot-notation-baseline.txt); only genuinely Mathlib-general lemmas go to `_root_` (line 96). Additionally `IsIntegralLattice` reads as the predicate form of the unrelated `TauCeti.IntegralLattice` (LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Basic.lean:61, a form-integral lattice in a rational space).

findings.evidence: Lattice.lean:347–355; the same `universe u' v'` and `variable {N …}` appear again at :349/:351 and :359/:361.
findings.fix: Delete lines 347–355 entirely; `NormedSpace.toModule` already supplies `Module ℝ V₀`, and the duplicated universe/variable declarations are dead.
findings.issue: Lines 347–355 add a `private noncomputable instance moduleOfNormedSpace : Module ℝ E := NormedSpace.toModule`, duplicating Mathlib's `NormedSpace.toModule`, plus an `attribute [local instance 1001]` priority override and `universe`/`variable` lines that are immediately re-declared at 359–361. Being the most recently declared instance of equal priority, `TauCeti.moduleOfNormedSpace` is what `Module ℝ V₀` resolves to in the statements of `isDiscrete_range`, `discreteTopology_range` and `isZLattice_range` (via `IsIntegralLattice i`), i.e. a private, non-exported constant inside public statements; at best it is a redundant second path to `Module ℝ`.

findings.fix: Make `i` implicit (`{i : N →+ V}`) in all of these so `h.injective`, `h.span_range_eq_top`, `h.realBasis` work.
findings.issue: Every lemma takes `(i : N →+ V)` explicitly before `(h : IsIntegralLattice i)`, although `i` is determined by `h`'s type. Dot notation therefore requires re-supplying it — the file itself writes `h.span_range_eq_top i` (line 485). This affects `finiteDimensional`, `injective`, `realBasis`, `realBasis_apply`, `range_eq_span_realBasis`, `span_range_eq_top`, `finrank_eq_finrank`, `isDiscrete_range`, `discreteTopology_range`, `isZLattice_range`.

findings.evidence: Lattice.lean:380, 396–397, 412, 430–432, 474, 484 all re-derive `equiv (1 ⊗ₜ n) = i n` by hand; :495–496 exposes `h.baseChange.equiv.toLinearMap` in the public naturality statement.
findings.fix: Add `IsIntegralLattice.equiv : ℝ ⊗[ℤ] N ≃ₗ[ℝ] V := h.baseChange.equiv` with `@[simp] equiv_tmul : h.equiv (r ⊗ₜ n) = r • i n` and `@[simp] equiv_symm_apply : h.equiv.symm (i n) = 1 ⊗ₜ n`, state `comp_equiv_eq_equiv_comp_baseChange` through it, and add its pointwise form.
findings.issue: The characterizing datum — the equivalence `ℝ ⊗[ℤ] N ≃ₗ[ℝ] V` with `e (1 ⊗ₜ n) = i n` — is never exposed. Consumers must reach through `h.baseChange.equiv` and then rewrite `IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul` together with `AddMonoidHom.coe_toIntLinearMap`; the file performs exactly this unfolding six times, and the naturality theorem is stated in terms of the raw projection `h.baseChange.equiv.toLinearMap` with no applied form.

findings.evidence: Lattice.lean:415–437 (`hrange'` at :424, downgraded at :437); :473–475 converts back.
findings.fix: Export the submodule equality as the main lemma and derive the `Set`-level form from it if still needed.
findings.issue: `range_eq_span_realBasis` is stated as an equality of `Set V`, but its proof establishes the stronger submodule equality `hrange' : LinearMap.range i.toIntLinearMap = Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (realBasis i h))` (line 424) and then discards it. Consumers needing the submodule form (`ZSpan`, `IsZLattice`) must re-derive it, as `discreteTopology_range` already does with a `simpa` round-trip.

findings.evidence: Lattice.lean:371–373 fields; :401 and :408 `@Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ N _ _ _ h.free` in public types; :454–467 `private theorem isDiscrete_range_of_instances` applied as `@isDiscrete_range_of_instances N _ V₀ _ _ h.finite i h`.
findings.fix: Take `[Module.Free ℤ N] [Module.Finite ℤ N]` as instance arguments of `IsIntegralLattice` (the idiom already used for the same lattice pattern in TauCeti/Geometry/Hodge/PeriodDomain.lean:71 and Structure.lean:75), leaving `baseChange` as the content.
findings.issue: `Module.Free ℤ N` and `Module.Finite ℤ N` are stored as structure fields rather than instance hypotheses, so instance search never sees them and the public types must name the proof: `realBasis`/`realBasis_apply` have index type `@Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ N _ _ _ h.free`, and a private helper theorem exists solely to inject `h.finite`. Every Layer 0 consumer of this predicate inherits that plumbing.

summary: The new integral-lattice API is declared in the root `AddMonoidHom` namespace (colliding conceptually with the repo's existing `TauCeti.IntegralLattice`), ships a private duplicate `Module ℝ` instance, passes `i` explicitly everywhere so dot notation never works, exposes no accessor for the defining scalar-extension equivalence, and weakens its own range lemma to a `Set` equality.
